intro.title: Build API gateway like proxy endpoint
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple API gateway-like proxy endpoint using Node.js. This proxy will forward incoming HTTP requests to another server and return the response, acting as an intermediary. You'll learn the core concept of HTTP proxying and how to handle request and response streams. The main technologies involved are the built-in Node.js 'http' module and the 'http-proxy' npm package. By the end, you'll have a working proxy server that can route traffic, which is a foundational skill for building scalable backend systems.
intro.usecase: API gateways are fundamental infrastructure in modern web applications, acting as a single entry point that routes requests to appropriate backend services. In e-commerce platforms, gateways handle product searches, shopping cart updates, and payment processing by directing requests to separate inventory, cart, and payment microservices. Content delivery networks use proxy endpoints to cache and distribute media files globally, reducing latency for users accessing videos or images. Developers implement these patterns when building dashboard applications that aggregate data from multiple APIs into unified interfaces for analytics or monitoring systems.
